verdict.rationale: Plugin extensibility is a fair axis for a note-taking app, but the evidence shows no in-app plugin system, extension API, or SDK. Reflect documents an OAuth2 REST API (OpenAPI spec on openpm, curl example) and deep links for building external clients and integrations. Those are adjacent integration surfaces, not a documented way to build plugins that extend the app, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build my own plugins against a documented extension API/SDK with samples and developer docs
